name: Gravity Well
effect_level_1: Pulls anyone within 3 tiles to its centre and holds them 2 seconds.

name: Crystal Wall
effect_level_1: A breakable wall (800 health) that blocks a path. It can never close the last route to the Heart.

name: Time Snare
effect_level_1: Freezes the first character to step on it for 2.5 seconds.

name: Static Coil
effect_level_1: Shocks anyone within 2 tiles every 3 seconds.

name: Thorn Hedge
effect_level_1: Blocks a path and hurts anyone pushing through (5% health a second).

name: Lantern Glare
effect_level_1: Shows the crew to every guard in the realm for 5 seconds and blinds them for 2.
